candidate_encodings.description: The machine's proposed intervention and its predicted discriminating outcome must be submitted as fixed, deterministic artifacts whose description lengths are charged in full.
candidate_encodings.rule: No modification after the outcome is observed.

freeze_procedure: To be defined before freezing: profile hash published, intervention space declared, candidate submission window closed, then the intervention is executed once.
name: Active experiment selection
objective: The machine proposes the intervention that most discriminates between competing candidate explanations, and the intervention is executed once under the frozen profile.
quantity_measured: Turing gain (T) of the machine-proposed intervention design: the intervention that most reduces uncertainty between competing explanations, measured on the resulting sealed outcome.
seeds: All random seeds fixed and recorded in the profile before freezing.
uncertainty: Report with confidence intervals from the declared resampling procedure; recomputation by an independent party from the frozen profile must fall inside the reported envelope.
verdict_rules: The proposed intervention must be the one the machine selects as most discriminating under its declared selection rule before the outcome is observed.
Post-hoc selection of a different intervention after seeing the outcome invalidates the run.
The outcome is evaluated with the same sealed-data and recomputation rules as EXP-001/EXP-002.
